senses.gloss: She,Ⓒpron.ⒹsA; in comp. ex. by f. terminations, ‘s(he)-goat’ ajA, ‘s(he)-sparrow’ cawakA &c.
Sheaf,Ⓒs.Ⓓ(Sasya-)muzwi m. f., staMbaH, gucCaH, stabakaH.

Shear,Ⓒv. t.ⒹlU 9 U, kft 6 P, Cid 7 P, Avap c., muMq 1 P, 10, vi-, SF 9 P.
Ⓑ
 2 apahf 1 P, nirhf; ‘shorn of’ vIta, hfta, nir, hIna in comp.; See Destitute; ‘was shorn of his arms’ CinnabAhuH kftaH or tasya bAhU vyaSIryetAm.
Ⓝ[Shear]er,Ⓒs.ⒹlomacCid m. -cCedin, Cid in comp.
Ⓝ[Shear]ing,Ⓒs.ⒹlavanaM, kartanaM, vapanaM, CedaH-danaM.
ⓃShears,Ⓒs.ⒹKaMqaDArA, kartarikA, kartarI, kfpARI.

Sheath,Ⓒs.ⒹkoSaH-zaH, piDAnaM, ADAraH; A-, vezwanaM, puwaH-waM, AcCAdanaM.
Ⓑ
 2 dalaM.
ⓃSheathe,Ⓒv. t.ⒹkoSe ni-DA 3 U or niviS c.
Ⓑ
 2 A-pari-vezw 1 A or c., pi-DA, Avf 5 U, AcCad 10.

Shed,Ⓒv. t.Ⓓni-, pat c., vi-, muc 6 P or c., visfj 6 P, gal c.; ‘s(hed) tears’ bAzpaM vihf 1 P, aSrURi vi-, muc or pat c.
Ⓑ
 2 (Blood) sru c., pat c., muc, mokz 10; ‘s(hed) influence’ Pal 1 P; ‘the moon s(hed)s her white glory’ iMdurDavalaraSmijAlaM vikirati.
Ⓑ
 3 (Light) kzip 6 P, visfj, prakf 6 P, prasf c.
Ⓔs.ⒹSAlA; ‘s(hed) for cattle’ goSAlA, gozWaM.
Ⓝ[Shed]der,Ⓒs.ⒹsrAvakaH, mocakaH pAtakaH.

Sheen,Ⓒa.Ⓓujjvala, dIptimat; See Bright.
Ⓔs.ⒹpraBA, tejas n.

Sheep,Ⓒs.ⒹmezaH, aviH, uraBraH, UrRAyuH; See Ram; ‘a female s(heep)’ mezI, eqakA; ‘goats and s(heep)’ ajAvikaM; ‘flock of s(heep)’ OraBraM.
Ⓝ[Sheep]ish,Ⓒa.ⒹapratiBa, lajjASIla, janaBIta; nistejas, nizpraBa, hata-nazwa-gata-vIrya, meza-svaBAva-SIla.

Sheer,Ⓒa.ⒹSudDa, kevala, mAtra in comp.; See Bare, Mere.
Ⓔv. i.Ⓓvi-, apasf-sfp 1 P.

Sheet,Ⓒs.ⒹuttaracCadaH, pracCadaH, pracCadapawaH-vastraM, SayyAcCAdanaM.
Ⓑ
 2 (Of paper) patraM, PalakaM, KaMqaH, ekaBAgaH.
Ⓑ
 3 patraM, PalakaH-kaM (‘s(heet) of metal’); ‘winding-s(heet)’ preta-Sava-vastraM; ‘s(heet) of water’ jalasaMGAtaH, toyarASiH.

Shell,Ⓒs.ⒹkoSaH-zaH, kaMcukaH, kavacaH-caM, tvac f. (of fruit &c.); puwaH-waM; ‘bivalve s(hell)’ kaMbuH-bu; ‘conch-s(hell)’ SaMKaH; kaMbuH; ‘oyster-s(hell)’ Sukti f.; ‘dealer in s(hell)s’ SaMKakAraH, SAMKikaH; kAMbavikaH, ‘s(hell) of a pea’ SiMbA, bIjakoSaH; tuzaH (of rice).
Ⓑ
 2 A-pari-vezwanaM, puwaH, koSaH (envelope).
Ⓑ
 3 bahirBAgaH; ‘s(hell)-cutter’ kAMbavikaH; ‘s(hell)-fish’ kaMbusTaH, SaMKasTaH.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹkozaM-tvacaM &c. apanI 1 P or nirhf 1 P, nistvacIkf 8 U.
Ⓝ[Shell]y,Ⓒa.ⒹSaMKin, kaMbumaya (yI f.), -pUrRa.

Shelter,Ⓒs.ⒹsaM-A-SrayaH, SaraRaM, nivAsasTAnaM.
Ⓑ
 2 rakzaRaM, trARaM; ‘able to give s(helter)’ SaraRya; ‘take s(helter) with’ A-samA-Sri 1 U, SaraRaM yA 2 P or gam 1 P, SaraRArTaM yA.
Ⓔv. t.Ⓓ‘give s(helter)’ rakz 1 P, trE 1 A; See Protect; pra-, Cad 10, vyava-DA 3 U; ASrayaM dA 3 U, SaraRaM BU; ‘s(helter)ed from the wind’ nirvAta.
Ⓝ[Shelter]less,Ⓒa.ⒹnirASraya, nirAlaMba, aSaraRa.

Shelve,Ⓒv. i.Ⓓavasfp 1 P, pravaRIBU 1 P.

Ⓝ[Shelv]ing,Ⓒa.Ⓓavasarpin, pravaRa.
